test.title: Congratulating a friend on a new café

document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: I’ve just seen the photos of your new café on Instagram – congratulations! I’m so proud of you. You’ve been talking about opening your own place for as long as I can remember, and now you’ve actually done it!

Do you remember when we were students and you used to bake those amazing lemon cakes for everyone in our flat? I always said people would pay good money for them, so I’m not surprised you’ve put them on the menu.

I know the first few months of running a business can be really tiring, so if you ever need an extra pair of hands, just let me know. I’m free most Saturdays, and I’d be happy to help with anything – serving customers, washing up or even handing out leaflets in town.
I’m planning to come and visit next month, and I can’t wait to try everything. I’ll bring a few friends with me too, so get ready for some new customers!
Good luck with everything, and speak soon.

note.en: Contrasts the dream with the result.
Takes the reader back to the past.
A conclusion drawn from the memory.
A consequence: running a business is tiring, so help is offered.
Adds the most surprising way to help.
Adds another piece of good news.

strengths.en: “I’m so proud of you” and the reference to an old dream make it personal.
strengths.kk: «I’m so proud of you» және ескі арманды еске салу — құттықтау жеке естіледі.
strengths.ru: «I’m so proud of you» и напоминание о давней мечте — поздравление звучит лично.

strengths.en: The memory of the lemon cakes links the past to the new café.
strengths.kk: Лимон кекстері туралы естелік өткенді жаңа кафемен байланыстырады.
strengths.ru: Воспоминание про лимонные кексы связывает прошлое с новым кафе.

strengths.en: Not just “I can help” but when and how.
strengths.kk: Жай «I can help» емес, қашан және немен.
strengths.ru: Не просто «I can help», а когда и чем именно.
strengths.example: serving customers, washing up or even handing out leaflets

strengths.en: Present perfect, past simple, used to and will in one short letter.
strengths.kk: present perfect, past simple, used to, will — бір қысқа хатта.
strengths.ru: present perfect, past simple, used to, will — в одном коротком письме.
strengths.example: you used to bake those amazing lemon cakes

note.en: A friend, by first name: informal.
Congratulations at once and with feeling: bullet 1 is covered in the first paragraph.
note.kk: Құттықтау бірден әрі эмоциямен — тапсырманың 1-тармағы бірінші абзацта-ақ.
note.ru: Поздравление сразу и эмоционально — пункт 1 задания уже в первом абзаце.

note.en: Bullet 2: a shared memory connected to the café.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — общее воспоминание, связанное с кафе.

note.en: Bullet 3: an offer of help with specific tasks.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — предложение помощи с конкретными делами.

note.en: An extra point: plans to visit and bring customers — another form of support.
note.kk: Қосымша: келу және қонақтар әкелу жоспары — бұл да қолдау.
note.ru: Дополнение: план приехать и привести гостей — тоже поддержка.

note.en: “Lots of love” suits a close friend.

document.title: Congratulating a friend on a new café
bullets: remind them of something from the past connected to the business
document.question:
A friend has just opened their own small business.

Write a letter to your friend. In your letter
